evidence.name: Screen field: How long the progress runs
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How long the progress runs" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How long the progress runs
sections.description: Total time, in seconds (1-120), for the progress sequence to advance through all its steps before the screen continues. Aim for about 4-8 seconds: long enough to feel like real work is happening for the user, short enough to avoid drop-off. Use the play/pause preview to test the pacing against your step text.
